meta.name: product-marketing-copywriter
meta.description: 产品营销文案创作技能，支持多品类产品的吸引性营销文案生成，适用于产品推广、品牌营销、销售转化

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为产品生成吸引人的营销文案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为产品撰写有吸引力的营销文案
copy.tagline_en: Generate compelling marketing copy for your products
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to write attractive marketing copy for your products

howto.what: Claude会按标准流程为产品生成或优化营销文案：先收集产品信息，分析目标受众，提炼独特卖点，创作标题和正文（含引言、主体、结尾），加入数据、客户评价和行动号召，并依据情感词汇库调整语言。
howto.when: 当用户提出产品营销文案创作、文案优化，或需要为产品生成营销推广文案时触发。

say.text: 帮我的智能厨电写一条推广文案，突出智能控温和低油烟。
say.note: Claude会收集信息并生成带标题和CTA的文案。

say.text: 优化这段文案，让标题更吸引人，结尾加上限时优惠。
say.note: Claude会分析原稿并优化标题、正文与CTA。

say.text: 为我们的环保APP写三条文案，对象是年轻上班族。
say.note: Claude会按不同卖点产出多个版本。

howto.what_en: Claude generates or optimizes marketing copy for products: it collects product info, analyzes audience, identifies USP, writes titles and body, adds data, testimonials, and calls-to-action, and adjusts tone using an emotion-word library.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for product marketing copy creation, copy optimization, or promotional copy for a product.

say_en.text: Write a promo for my smart kitchen appliance, focusing on smart controls and low smoke.
say_en.note: Claude gathers info and generates copy with headline and CTA.

say_en.text: Optimize this copy: make the headline more catchy and add a limited-time offer at the end.
say_en.note: Claude analyses and improves headline, body, and CTA.

say_en.text: Write three versions of marketing copy for our eco-friendly app targeting young office workers.
say_en.note: Claude produces multiple variants highlighting different benefits.
